🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 6, 2026

Moon, in Libra, holds an opposition to Saturn, in its fall in Aries. Two different appetites, forced into one conversation: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Libra sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fire moves first and pays first. A week ago Mars was still held by Mercury; that is finished.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Scorpio, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Earth keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Venus has been out of Scorpio for four weeks now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Libra, Moon makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Mutable air: two answers, neither expensive. The square to Mars that held a week ago has let go.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Libra, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. Moon sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Fire keeps what it has, cheaply. Since Sun crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, is only passing through Scorpio. From Scorpio, Sun hands you an opening. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Retrograde since two weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal air: beginning and paying are one act. The hold Pluto had a week ago is not there any more.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Fixed water: the holding and the held stop differing. It arrived inside the last seven days.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Moon in Libra opens a gap you have to step into. Fire bends, and bending costs nothing here. Unchanged for four weeks: you know what it asks.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Libra presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Cardinal earth: the beginning has a price on it. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon in Libra sides with you before you have argued. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Sun in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Mutable water keeps two accounts, and both balance. Mercury let go of it a week ago.
